documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara manufacturing facility. Management reported strong revenue and PAT growth for both the quarter and the full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and backward integration into textile binder and table glue manufacturing. The company outlined priorities for FY2027 including scaling manufacturing capacity utilization to 100%, shifting the revenue mix towards a 50:50 balance between trading and manufacturing, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited reported its financial performance for Q4 FY26 and FY26, highlighting a strategic transition from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model. The company successfully commenced production at its new 72,000 square feet automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, which has an installed capacity of approximately 500 tonnes per month.

guidance.claim: Management expects full plant capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company targets overall EBITDA expansion of 2% to 3% at full capacity.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve a 50:50 revenue contribution between manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: Plus, our distribution of business for wood-coating, the current contribution of 6%, the growth of that can also double. Meaning we can even take it from INR6 crores to INR12 crores, INR14 crores.

guidance.claim: Trading revenue is expected to remain stable or grow by 10% to 20% in the current year, with manufacturing as the priority.
guidance.quote: So basically, this year we are prioritizing manufacturing only. So, for trading we can expect stable or 1% to 2%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to selectively expand its market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment due to improving demand trends.
guidance.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its guidance to close the year around INR 110 crores.
guidance.quote: Prateek Chaudhary: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed? Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity at its new plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing revenues to be equal within one to two years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

guidance.claim: The company aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
guidance.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, the manufacturing facility can generate around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores of turnover.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is receiving a very good response from customers in the domestic market for wood-coating products due to increasing awareness of getting out of solvents.
demand_outlook.quote: So, people are looking for solvent-free solutions. And where we are getting very good business as a domestic player.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is encouraged by improving demand trends in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Global apparel and lifestyle brands are expanding their procurement footprint in India due to challenges in Bangladesh.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has received a very good response and growth momentum after starting its manufacturing unit.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes after starting this manufacturing unit we get a very good response, so we get a good growth momentum.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Future manufacturing capacity expansion through additional vessels would cost around INR3 crores to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned an automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking a strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has successfully commenced production at its 72,000 square feet automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company has successfully commenced production at its a 72,000 sq ft state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commenced commercial production at its first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added a Kochi office in the quarter for domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

capex_expansion.claim: The company does not require more capex for further expansion as the factory was set up with utility, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity for expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned its expansion within the next six months.
capex_expansion.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration into manufacturing is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: The manufacturing segment EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, whereas the trading business is 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned to a manufacturing-led model to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to reduce costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% in Q3 FY26 from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects manufacturing margins to be near about 50% in the coming time.
margins_costs.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

margins_costs.claim: The company's reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% since starting manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

margins_costs.claim: The company has not seen any significant changes in basic raw material prices in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company utilized around 60% capacity of the plant in the first 2 months of starting manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's plant ran for only 2 months, which is about 45 days, in Q3.
orders_capacity.quote: Actually our plant has run for only 2 months, actually November and December only, you can consider it about 45 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects working capital not to become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores is a bank loan and INR 20 crores was funded through IPO, internal accruals, and unsecured loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores manufacturing plant investment is between 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's term loan is INR 30 crores and working capital is INR 20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The tenure of the long-term loan is 7 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's exports were previously down due to the US market.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a bit down in between due to the US, now it has started, so exports might even increase.

management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.quote: Our primary focus is on scaling operations in new markets, which offer us the potential to grow our client base and increase revenue.

management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
